name: clarcade
description: Caro (Gomoku) for two players on your LAN while Claude Code works.

language.title: Language
language.description: auto, en or vi. auto follows the system locale.

notifications.title: Turn notifications
notifications.description: band, toast, sound or off: how Clarcade announces your turn.

nickname.title: Player name
nickname.description: Name shown to the other player.

udpPort.title: LAN discovery port
udpPort.description: Port shared by players for LAN discovery.

nodePath.title: Absolute path to Node
nodePath.description: Leave blank to discover Node automatically.

allowTailscale.title: Allow Tailscale IPv4
allowTailscale.description: Allow connections to and from the 100.64.0.0/10 range. Applies when no room is open.

allowIpv6Ula.title: Allow IPv6 ULA
allowIpv6Ula.description: Allow direct links and connections to and from fd00::/8. Applies when no room is open.

board.title: Board style
board.description: grid or dots: draw the board as a square grid or as dots.

pieces.title: Piece style
pieces.description: xo, oo or pixel: draw pieces as X/O, circles or squares.
